title: Worldwide Remote Jobs Scraper - Jobs Open to Your Country

candidateCountry.title: Candidate's country
candidateCountry.description: Where the candidate lives and will work from. Each job is labelled against this country: worldwide, open to your country/region, restricted elsewhere, or unclear.

keywords.title: Keywords (any of)
keywords.description: Keep a job if its title, tags or description contains ANY of these. Leave empty for all jobs.

titleMustMatch.title: Match keywords in the title only
titleMustMatch.description: Stricter: the keyword has to be in the job title, not only in the description.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude titles containing
excludeKeywords.description: Drop a job if its TITLE contains any of these (e.g. senior, staff, principal, manager).

eligibility.title: Which jobs to return
eligibility.description: 'eligible' = worldwide + open to your country or region. 'eligible_and_unclear' also keeps jobs that do not state a restriction. 'all' returns everything, labelled.
enumTitles: Only jobs I can apply to
Jobs I can apply to + unclear ones

maxYearsRequired.title: Max years of experience required
maxYearsRequired.description: Drop jobs whose description asks for more than this many years. Jobs that state no number are kept. Leave empty to disable.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Only jobs published in the last N days.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Which open feeds to read. All are public JSON/RSS endpoints: no login, no cookies, no proxy needed.

maxItems.title: Maximum jobs to return
maxItems.description: Hard cap on rows pushed to the dataset (you are only charged for rows returned).

includeDescription.title: Include full description
includeDescription.description: Adds the plain-text job description to every row (bigger output).
